caption: The drawing depicts a single, old-fashioned metal kettle positioned against a plain, beige background. The kettle is rendered in shades of dark brown and has a weathered and textured surface. Its lid is open and attached to the kettle with a hinge, revealing the dark interior. The lid is circular with a raised, radiating pattern on its underside. The kettle has an angular, projecting spout on the right side and a thick, slightly flared base. The handle, visible near the spout, is short and connects to the body of the kettle. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition, which is centered on the page. The artist's signature is in small print at the bottom right.
title: Tea Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
